# image-generation-feature — analysis (generated by analyst on 2026-08-08)

## Problem

Carve the fully-specified `/image` feature (spec promotion landed as D73–D77
plus the commands.md catalogue entry, messaging.md attachment SPI bullets, and
the security.md §Secrets handling enumeration) into small, implementable
tickets. The design layer is `docs/design/future/image-generation.md`
(including the 2026-08-07 addendum: container overlay, wizard step, 3 models ×
2 tiers, ship blockers as acceptance criteria); the design-time redteam
(`docs/plan/m1/redteam/image-spec-promotion-2026-08-07.md`, 0 critical / 2 high
/ 3 medium / 2 low) is recorded as fully fixed in the spec — this analysis
verified each fix (see Ground truth). Work areas per the brief: P1 container +
setup wizard step; P2 outbound media SPI (payload record, capability flags,
SimpleX + Signal codecs, OutboundDelivery path, tmpfs spool + age sweeper, PNG
metadata strip); P3 the `/image` command.

## Ground truth

Verified against the tree on 2026-08-08:

**Spec (the contract, already promoted):**

- D73–D77 exist verbatim at `docs/spec/decisions.md:92-96`: config-gated
  command in DM+groups, absent from the slow-start allowed set (D73);
  attachment SPI = one payload shape `(scope, file path, MIME type, display
  filename)` + `supportsOutboundAttachments` + `maxOutboundAttachmentBytes`,
  file *path* because signal-cli attaches by path and SimpleX transfer is
  async past `send()` (D74); prompt is message content — content-free
  `IMAGE_GENERATE` audit row, no prompt hash, verifiable backend no-retention

  (D75); charge-on-attempt credits, refund iff the GPU never ran, in-memory

  host, translation leg follows `translator` routing and may be remote under

- The `/image` catalogue entry is at `docs/spec/commands.md:586-648`: grammar

**Discrepancies (brief/design vs. verified code):**

- D-1: The redteam-fix summary (design addendum :490) says "/image joins the
  D35 interruptible-concurrency ceiling" is fixed in spec. commands.md:610-613
  does carry it, but security.md §Rate limiting's D35 enumeration
  (security.md:1851-1857) still reads "chat replies, on-demand `/summary`,
  `/retry` re-rolls except `--digest`" — the ceiling's own defining list was
  not amended. Not a SPEC-GAP (commands.md is normative and sufficient);
  M1-803 carries a rides-the-diff amendment (M1-779 precedent) adding `/image`
  to that enumeration, rule-text only, wording user-approved (§12).
- D-2: The design (:309) says "`LlmHttpSupport` already provides the
  bounded-response, timeout and transport-failure helpers." Verified: every
  helper is a package-private static in `app.zcat.infochat.llm.impl`
  (LlmHttpSupport.java:90-420) and the bounded body handler is String-shaped
  (:420) — unusable for binary image bytes from infochat-provider without
  visibility/API changes. M1-802 implements its own bounded byte read.
- D-3: The design (:176) says RateCapBucket holds "seven maps today" — seven
  named bucket maps plus the stranger limiter; immaterial, noted for
  precision.
- D-4 (ASSUMPTIONS the implementors must verify; not verifiable offline):
  ComfyUI endpoint shapes — `POST /interrupt` vs queue-delete for cancel, the
  `/history` clear mechanism, `/queue` response shape (the design itself says
  "verify the endpoint at design time"); the simplex-chat CLI file-send wire
  command and XFTP completion event; SimpleX/Signal attachment size ceilings
  (future-features.md §B2 :114-116 lists them as unverified); whether ComfyUI
  stdout prints prompt text.

## Root cause

Not a defect — a feature carve. The causal fact the decomposition hangs on:
the outbound adapter path is text-only end to end (SPI, record, codecs,
OutboundDelivery), verified above, so the feature's bulk is new plumbing, and
every privacy/rate control the spec mandates must be built into that plumbing
at the point it is created — retrofitting the D75 no-content chain or the D76
refund boundary onto shipped plumbing is exactly the failure shape the
redteam's findings 3–6 describe.

## Pitfalls

- P1: CapabilityFlags positional-record cascade — 9 constructor sites across
  2 modules plus capability-assertion tests (M1-274 lesson: its refine was
  forced by exactly this cascade). Missing one fails compile; a test double
  must declare honest values, not convenient ones.
- P2: The `supportsOutboundAttachments` gate is STATIC — check it before
  charging credits and before generating. D76's no-refund list covers
  post-GPU failures; "adapter cannot carry attachments" is knowable
  pre-attempt and must never consume a credit. Spec: messaging.md:139-140,
  :206-211 (Provider never invokes on a false flag).
- P3: Spool lifecycle — delete-on-completion alone leaks a file on every
  Provider crash between fetch and send; the age sweeper is the guarantee
  (design :105-110). Sweeper eviction is time-decision logic → injected
  `Clock` (engineering-rules §9); tmpfs is RAM, so the spool needs the
  spec'd capacity bound (commands.md:634-636) and writes must refuse past
  it, never grow unbounded.
- P4: The D75 no-content chain is only as strong as its weakest link: prompt
  never logged on ANY path including error/timeout (SafeLog discipline;
  `OutboundDelivery.onCapExhausted` at :345-363 is the precedent for keeping
  exception messages that may quote payloads out of logs), never persisted,
  content-free `IMAGE_GENERATE` row only, no prompt hash (dictionary-attack
  rationale, decisions.md:94).
- P5: PNG metadata strip — ComfyUI embeds the whole workflow graph (prompt,
  model paths, server-side negative prompt) in PNG text chunks; delivery
  without stripping ships the raw prompt inside the pixels' container
  (D75). Strip at chunk level (tEXt/zTXt/iTXt), copying surviving chunks
  verbatim so CRCs stay valid; pixel-bound check reads IHDR dimensions —
  the Provider must never inflate IDAT (a decompression bomb would then be
  OUR memory bug; client-side rendering is out of model per the redteam's
  OUT-OF-MODEL list).
- P6: The echo is attacker-influenced text in the bot's voice — sanitize at
  render with `LlmOutputSanitizer.sanitize`, redaction unit = the echo field
  ALONE, never the joined reply (§10 granularity; M1-694: restoring the call
  but widening the unit changed what span-deletion could reach). The
  `](`-free chokepoint downstream is preserved by construction.
- P7: Endpoint-chosen bytes (security.md §Trust boundaries item 9): the
  `/view` body is read under a profile-driven byte cap BEFORE the spool
  write. LlmHttpSupport's bounded helpers are package-private and
  String-shaped (discrepancy D-2) — the client carries its own bounded byte
  read; do not widen llm-adapter API surface as a side quest (§3).
- P8: SSRF — `infochat.image.base-url` is operator config, not user input;
  security.md:198-207 scopes the fail-closed allowlist to feeds/redirects/
  StreamSource/`/add-source` probes. Routing the backend call through
  infochat-ssrf would BLOCK the loopback/private address the feature
  requires. Record the configured-internal exemption (design :314-315);
  item 9's hostile-endpoint posture is the compensating control (P7).
- P9: Timeout must CANCEL, not abandon — an abandoned ComfyUI job keeps
  burning GPU exactly when the queue is deep (design :215-220). Cancel
  endpoint shape (`POST /interrupt` vs queue delete) is an ASSUMPTION to
  verify at implementation (D-4); `/stop`'s interrupt must reach the same
  cancellation path.
- P10: D35 enrollment — `InboundRouter.isInterruptible` must add `image`, or
  `/image` runs on the transport thread, escaping the per-user concurrency
  ceiling AND `/stop` (redteam finding 4: the longest interruptible work in
  the system). The security.md enumeration amendment (discrepancy D-1) is
  rule-text only, landed on the user's explicit yes (§12).
- P11: Config-gated absence vs. the parity axes — bean, CATALOGUE entry, and
  the marked-index `/image` line land together (commands.md:645-648). Absence
  is RUNTIME gating: `/help`'s `visible()` filter plus the unknown-command
  body (ERROR_UNKNOWN_COMMAND, InboundRouter.java:1803) when invoked. A
  build-time-conditional bean desyncs CommandCatalogueParityTest's CDI bean
  graph in `@QuarkusTest` — do not use `@IfBuildProperty` here.
- P12: Credit buckets — two new RateCapBucket maps (per-user, per-group,
  hourly) with Settings components, withers, and eviction enrollment whose
  effective threshold is `max(evictionThreshold, refillWindow)` (the M1-222
  rebirth-full-early lesson, RateCapBucket.java:653-655). The gate is an AND;
  a refund returns BOTH; charge happens before the backend call; the
  refund-iff-GPU-never-ran boundary (unreachable / breaker open / queue over
  budget / timeout-before-start / Provider crash — refund; adapter-send
  failure / over-limit attachment / generated — no refund) must be exact.
- P13: Cooldown is per-user in DM AND group (D76), decision-time logic →
  injected `Clock`, and never split one component's write/read across two
  clocks (§9).
- P14: Translation leg reuse inherits QueryAnchorTranslator's semantics: en
  strict no-op; on failure the ORIGINAL (non-English) prompt goes to the
  backend — degraded adherence for Mage-Flow/Z-Image (measured, design
  :243-248), not an error — and the 24h cache residual (already disclosed,
  security.md:2149-2157). The leg resolves to `ModelTask.TRANSLATOR`, which
  may be remote: switch-llm.sh ("SEVEN distinct legs"), SETUP_GUIDE.md's
  leg-by-leg section, and 4-llm.sh must name the `/image` leg — a leg
  missing from the enumeration propagates into both texts
  (security.md:2144-2148).
- P15: Server-built graph — user text reaches exactly one JSON string field
  (`CLIPTextEncode.text`) via a JSON serializer; never string-interpolate
  into a graph template. The endpoint is code execution on the hosting box
  (D77); interpolation is an RCE vector, not an injection nit.
- P16: Every new `infochat.image.*` `@ConfigProperty` key must be documented
  in design notes or exempted — DocumentedConfigKeyParityTest (M1-708) gates
  the documented-vs-real key sets; the design-doc edits ride the tickets
  (messaging.md:550-553 delegates payload shape, spool lifecycle, and
  per-adapter ceilings to design notes).
- P17: SimpleX XFTP lifetime (ship blocker, unverified — D-4): the file must
  remain readable for the whole transmit, which completes asynchronously past
  `send()`'s return; the completion signal M1-800 waits on must be verified
  against the bundled simplex-chat version. If no completion event exists,
  escalate — do not guess (the age sweeper remains the backstop either way).
  The adapter MUST NOT retain or copy the payload beyond delivery
  (messaging.md:137-138).
- P18: Attachment ceilings (ship blocker, unverified — D-4):
  `maxOutboundAttachmentBytes` values for SimpleX and Signal must be
  measured/verified, not invented; they bound the `--resolution` ceiling
  however the pixels are produced (commands.md:596-599). signal-cli attaches
  by file path, so the spool file must be visible to the adapter subprocess
  for the whole send including OutboundDelivery retries (P3 interplay).
- P19: Probation — `/image` stays OUT of `CommandPermissions.ALLOWED`; the
  closed list fails closed for free (D73). Adding it is a spec amendment;
  the blocked reply during probation is CORRECT behavior, not a bug to fix.
- P20: Failure contract — all 8 enumerated modes return localized text
  (bundle keys in en AND cs, D43), never silence; none of the texts may
  contain the prompt (P4) or an un sanitized echo (P6).
- P21: Container bind — no host port in the overlay default; the Provider
  reaches ComfyUI over the compose network (the llamacpp item-8 precedent,
  security.md:86-90). Two-box exposure is an explicit operator action with
  the port firewalled to the single Provider host (D77); the rootless-docker
  `group_add` trap (docker-compose.gpu.yml header, M1-744) applies to
  `/dev/kfd` + `/dev/dri`; the launch flags `--disable-mmap --bf16-vae
  --highvram` + `TORCH_ROCM_AOTRITON_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL=1` are load-bearing
  measurements, not tunables.
- P22: Wizard honesty — the 4.38 s Mage-Flow number was conda-measured; the
  wizard prints only container re-measured numbers (design :370-371). Offer
  local install only on GPU-capable profiles (never `pi`/`vps`; profiles are
  `laptop vps pi remote-llm`), remote-URL path or "not enabled" otherwise;
  preflight HEAD-checks + disk/VRAM before any download; dedupe the shared
  `qwen3vl_4b` encoder blob; print the D77 firewall requirement for the
  two-box form.
- P23: The OutboundDelivery attachment path preserves the chokepoint's
  incidental obligations (§10): the TRANSIENT/PERMANENT ladder with the same
  bounded retry, per-group permanent-failure attribution (an image send into
  a group that fails permanently feeds the BOT_REMOVED counter exactly as a
  text send), adapterMetrics emission, D64 at-least-once acceptance (an
  ambiguous attachment transmit may duplicate; no correlationId dedup —
  OutboundMessage.java:14-20). Attachment bodies never pass through the
  text-only `](`-neutralizer — and must not need to.
- P24: Backend no-retention end state (D75 ship blocker): submitted-graph
  history cleared after each job (clear mechanism an ASSUMPTION — D-4) AND
  output files removed. ComfyUI has no delete API (design :96-99), so the
  container image carries the output dir on tmpfs plus an aged-file janitor;
  the acceptance probe asserts, after a full job: `/history` contains no
  prompt text, no leftover output files, and container stdout is prompt-free.
- P25: Fixture calibration across siblings — M1-799 pins
  `supportsOutboundAttachments=false` for SimpleX/Signal as the INTERIM
  state and pre-authorizes M1-800's flip (named here, carried in M1-800's
  `test_plan.modifies`); the InMemoryAdapter declares `true` from M1-799 so
  Provider-side paths are testable before the production codecs exist.

## Solution options

1. **Chosen: the seven-ticket decomposition below** — container, wizard, SPI,
   codecs, spool+strip, client, handler. Matches the brief's P1/P2/P3 areas
   and the dependency graph; each ticket is independently verifiable.
2. **Build-time bean gating for the config-absent command** (`@IfBuildProperty`
   on the handler): rejected — desyncs CommandCatalogueParityTest's
   bean-graph axis in `@QuarkusTest` (P11); runtime gating is the D73
   "capability gating" shape and keeps all three parity axes static.
3. **DB-backed credit ledger**: rejected by D76 itself — in-memory buckets,
   restart refills, accepted on an invite-only instance. (Recording because
   "credit" implies ledger; the spec settled this.)
4. **`ImageGenerationProvider` SPI + new module**: rejected by design
   decision 13 — one backend, plain HTTP, one class in the Provider until a
   second backend exists.
5. **Async completion callback on the attachment SPI** vs. blocking-until-
   completion: the blocking shape is chosen — the adapter reports delivery
   completion by RETURNING (success or classified failure), which is the
   minimal surface satisfying messaging.md:134-138 with no new callback
   contract; SimpleX's async transfer is awaited inside the adapter (P17).
6. **Routing backend egress through infochat-ssrf**: rejected (P8) — the gate
   is scoped to user-controlled URLs and would block the required loopback/
   private address; the exemption is recorded per the design.

## Chosen approach

Option 1, seven tickets, spec_refs per decision as cited in each ticket:

- **M1-797 comfyui-gpu-overlay** (docker/prod artifacts; no Maven module):
  `docker-compose.comfyui.yml` overlay (compose-network-only, `/dev/kfd` +
  `/dev/dri`), purpose-built ROCm image with the load-bearing launch flags,
  tmpfs output dir + aged-file janitor (P24), stdout prompt-free probe (P4),
  container re-measure of per-model latency (P22). Implements D77 (one-box
  form), feeds P24's acceptance probe.
- **M1-798 image-setup-wizard-step** (prod/scripts; blocked_by M1-797 — it
  prints M1-797's re-measured numbers and drives M1-797's overlay): numbered
  step in setup.sh STEPS, profile-gated (never pi/vps local), 3 models × 2
  curated tiers with honest numbers + disk table, preflight HEAD/disk/VRAM,
  download with qwen3vl_4b dedupe, healthcheck via `/system_stats`, D77
  firewall requirement printed for the two-box form, re-run/edit path.
  Implements D73/D77.
- **M1-799 outbound-attachment-spi** (infochat-messaging-adapter): payload
  record, `sendAttachment` default method, two CapabilityFlags components +
  cascade sweep (P1), InMemoryAdapter fill-in declaring `true` (P25),
  SimpleX/Signal interim `false`, design-doc SPI update (P16). Implements
  D74 + messaging.md:128-144/:206-216.
- **M1-800 adapter-attachment-codecs** (infochat-messaging-adapter;
  blocked_by M1-799): SimpleX + Signal `sendAttachment` implementations and
  wire encoding, XFTP completion-event verification (P17), measured ceilings
  flipping both production flags to `true` (P18, P25), design-doc ceilings
  (P16). Implements D74 + messaging.md:552-553.
- **M1-801 image-spool-and-png-strip** (infochat-provider; blocked_by
  M1-799): tmpfs spool with capacity bound + injected-Clock age sweeper (P3),
  PNG text-chunk strip with IHDR pixel bound (P5), `OutboundDelivery`
  attachment path with flag gate, pre-invocation size refusal, full retry
  ladder, group attribution, metrics (P2, P23), completion-driven delete
  (messaging.md:134-138). Implements D74/D75 + commands.md:633-636.
- **M1-802 comfyui-client-graph-builder** (infochat-provider; blocked_by
  none for code — stub-server tests; the live no-retention probe needs
  M1-797's container and is named as such): `infochat.image.*` config, one
  Provider-side client class, server-built graph via serializer (P15),
  bounded byte read (P7), SSRF exemption recorded (P8), `/queue` depth read,
  timeout/stop cancellation (P9), post-job history clear + the D75
  no-retention acceptance probe (P24). Implements commands.md:609-615,
  :631-636, D75, D77.
- **M1-803 image-command-handler** (infochat-provider; blocked_by M1-800,
  M1-801, M1-802): handler bean + CATALOGUE entry + marked-index line
  together (P11), runtime config gate, parser with prompt cap, cooldown +
  dual credit buckets + queue gate (P12, P13), isInterruptible enrollment +
  the rides-the-diff security.md amendment (P10, D-1), translation leg +
  disclosure-text updates (P14), sanitized echo (P6), content-free audit
  (P4), 8-mode localized failure contract (P20), probation untouched (P19).
  Implements the whole commands.md entry + D73/D76.

Order rationale: 797 first (it produces the re-measured numbers 798 prints
and the environment 802's live probe needs); 799 → 800 (codecs need the SPI)
and 799 → 801 (delivery path needs the SPI method; tested against the
in-memory fill-in, so 801 does not wait for 800); 802 any time after 797
starts; 803 last, assembling everything. Module note for --parallel: 799 and
800 share infochat-messaging-adapter; 801/802/803 share infochat-provider —
the dependency chain already serializes them, so the module rule costs
nothing extra.

## Controls to preserve (engineering-rules §10)

For every path the change reroutes or extends:

- OutboundDelivery's retry ladder, per-group BOT_REMOVED attribution, and
  adapterMetrics emission carry over to the attachment path (P23); the
  text-only `](`-neutralizer stays text-only and untouched (P6).
- `LlmOutputSanitizer.sanitize` + its `LLM_OUTPUT_SANITIZED` audit row are
  ADDED on the echo field (new surface, redteam finding 3) with the field as
  the unit (P6); no existing sanitize call moves.
- The probation closed list is untouched (P19); the step-1.5 transport bucket
  and per-group command/LLM buckets keep firing before any `/image` gate
  (rate-limit ordering at InboundRouter is unchanged).
- The per-user interruptible concurrency check at InboundRouter.java:1044-1051
  fires for `/image` the moment `isInterruptible` admits it — no new check
  site (P10).
- SafeLog discipline on every new error path that could carry backend
  response text or the prompt (P4); QueryAnchorTranslator's no-content
  logging posture is inherited, not weakened (P14).
- CommandCatalogueParityTest's three axes stay green by construction (P11) —
  the ticket set never deletes an index line, catalogue entry, or bean alone.
- Existing capability-contract tests (AdapterCapabilityContractTest and
  friends) keep pinning honest per-adapter values through the P1 cascade.

## Verification strategy

Every pitfall maps to a test or probe in the owning ticket (named per ticket;
the headline ones):

- P1 → compile + the swept constructor sites' existing tests stay green;
  AdapterCapabilityContractTest gains flag-value pins.
- P2 → handler/gate unit test: false-flag adapter → text fallback, zero
  credits drawn, client never invoked (M1-801 for the gate; M1-803
  end-to-end).
- P3 → sweeper unit test with a fixed Clock (evicts aged, keeps fresh);
  capacity-bound write-refusal test (failure-mode: over-capacity write is
  refused, nothing partial left).
- P4/P5 → PngMetadataStripTest: a PNG carrying the prompt in tEXt/iTXt chunks
  strips to bytes containing no prompt substring; oversized IHDR dimensions
  refused (failure-mode); provider-side log-grep probe over a forced error
  path asserts no prompt text.
- P6 → handler test: prompt containing a privileged command string renders
  `[redacted command]` in the echo and writes the sanitizer audit row.
- P7 → client test against a stub HTTP server: over-cap body is refused
  before the spool write (failure-mode: hostile endpoint streaming garbage).
- P9 → client test: timeout issues the cancel call (stub asserts the
  cancellation request arrived); `/stop` interrupt path test in M1-803.
- P10 → router test: `/image` dispatches interruptibly (per-user cap reply
  when at ceiling); grep probe on the amended security.md enumeration
  (rule-text only — no dates/ticket IDs).
- P11 → CommandCatalogueParityTest stays green (it IS the test); handler
  test: no base-url → unknown-command body and `/help` absence.
- P12 → bucket tests: AND-gate (one side empty → reject), paired refund,
  eviction threshold ≥ window; handler tests pin each refund/no-refund arm
  of D76.
- P14 → handler test: cs scope → translator called, English prompt used and
  echoed; translator failure → original prompt reaches the graph (failure-
  mode); grep probes on the three disclosure texts naming the /image leg.
- P15 → graph-builder test: prompt containing JSON metacharacters lands as
  exactly one string field's value; the serialized graph parses and contains
  the prompt nowhere else.
- P17/P18 → M1-800 verification probes against the real transports +
  recorded values in the design doc; codec unit tests pin the wire encoding.
- P20 → failure-mode tests feeding each of the 8 modes; each asserts the
  localized body and (where applicable) the refund state.
- P21/P24 → M1-797/M1-802 live probes: compose config validation,
  healthcheck, post-job `/history` + output-dir + stdout prompt-free
  assertions (the D75 acceptance check).

## Decomposition

Seven tickets M1-797…M1-803 as listed under Chosen approach. Dependencies:
798 ← 797; 800 ← 799; 801 ← 799; 802 ⇢ 797 (live probe only); 803 ← 800,
801, 802. Each ticket embeds its slice of this analysis; the implementor
reads the ticket, not this document.

## SPEC-GAP

None. The spec (D73–D77, commands.md, messaging.md, security.md) supports
every design decision above. One rides-the-diff amendment (discrepancy D-1,
security.md §Rate limiting D35 enumeration) ships with M1-803 as rule-text
only under §12; it records behavior commands.md:610-613 already commits to.
